plugin.name: Windows Settings
plugin.description: Add common Windows Settings pages to search; enable or disable individual entries in settings
source.name: Windows Settings Source
source.description: Creates search candidates for common Settings pages (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, display, updates, ...) and opens them via cmd
field.enabled.label: Enabled entries
field.enabled.desc: Checked entries become search candidates; unchecking all disables the data source.
field.enabled.note: Changes refresh the candidate cache immediately; no host restart needed.
